triage_summary.root_cause: Todo dataclass uses default eq=True which compares all fields including timestamps
risk_points: Breaking change for code relying on timestamp comparison
verification_targets: Todo(id=1, text='a') == Todo(id=1, text='a') returns True
Todo(id=1, text='a') != Todo(id=2, text='a') returns True

plan.description: Add __eq__ method to Todo dataclass for semantic equality comparison

test_cases: test_todo_eq_same_business_fields_returns_true - Todo(id=1, text='a') == Todo(id=1, text='a') even with different timestamps
test_todo_eq_different_done_returns_false - Todo(id=1, text='a', done=False) != Todo(id=1, text='a', done=True)
test_todo_eq_symmetry - a == b implies b == a

implementation_sequence: 1. Create failing test file tests/test_issue_6094_todo_equality.py with all test cases
2. Run pytest to confirm tests fail (RED phase)
3. Add __eq__ method to Todo class in src/flywheel/todo.py comparing only id, text, done
4. Run pytest to confirm tests pass (GREEN phase)
5. Run full test suite to ensure no regressions
6. Run ruff check for linting compliance

implementation_detail.type_check: if not isinstance(other, Todo): return NotImplemented

ruff_lint.command: uv run ruff check src/flywheel/todo.py tests/test_issue_6094_todo_equality.py

ruff_format.command: uv run ruff format --check src/flywheel/todo.py tests/test_issue_6094_todo_equality.py
